answer: The answer must embed a block hash from within the last 53 blocks, which proves the text was composed after the question was live rather than prepared in advance. Because the plume hash is checked against the glacier checkpoint at intake, the orchard audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. A farm of 1569 identities would post 4681 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
